items.q: How are upgrades and downgrades billed?
items.a: Upgrades take effect immediately: the remaining days of your current plan are prorated and credited against the new order. Downgrades apply at the end of the current cycle, with no refund.
Alipay transfer and corporate bank transfer for now — payments are typically verified and activated within 1 business day. Online WeChat Pay / Alipay checkout is coming soon.
Enterprise offers on-prem deployment, custom quotas and dedicated support. Contact sales@vxture.com and we respond within 1 business day.
